standing: candidate design contract; no active host adapter or grant selected
wire_authority: workspaces/products/define/implementation/cli/alchlang/preparation/contracts.alch plus exact generated application manifest/codec; do not maintain a competing hand-written DTO schema
requests: MeaningLookup exposes LookupRequest and LookupObservation; SemanticNotes exposes NoteRequest/NoteCommand/SessionView; JournalObservationBoundary exposes JournalObservation/SessionView; PreparationBoundary exposes the typed candidate/preparation/handoff values

bindings.logical_path: 1..192 ASCII letters/digits/underscore/hyphen; immutable local document handles, not arbitrary original filesystem paths
bindings.original_locations: Full original paths, prose, source IDs and long selectors are retained in byte-bound manifest/documents; the handle is an explicit reference, not truncation or a canonical identity alias
bindings.document_bytes: 0..16777216; independent current source/profile budgets also apply
bindings.read_contract: Use existing anchored original-byte and JSON/schema adapters; reject symlinks, traversal and changed observations where the selected adapter contract requires it.
bindings.representation_boundary: Define.Design.Contracts.Binding is a bounded design-document handle, not assignment-compatible with Define.Shared.Binding or arbitrary portable source paths. The selected adapter retains the full original binding in its bound manifest and checks the explicit handle/original-byte correspondence. Canonical selected-JSON digests remain distinct from original-file SHA-256.

observation_boundary.journal: Trusted observer must read/replay the actual canonical journal, compare the selected exact epoch/cut and snapshot, and derive SessionView from those bytes before invoking RefreshProjectionEntry. The observer may not certify arbitrary caller-provided counts.
observation_boundary.lookup: Compute actual_request from the exact typed request bytes; bind catalog snapshot, declared searched scope, result inventory and relevant selected request. ValidateLookup records a reported observation and never promotes source authority or applicability.
observation_boundary.candidate_fields: InspectCandidateFields derives a report for the supplied bounded field batch. It does not claim that a zero-length batch covers the full candidate. Full manifest/schema/fidelity/lineage checks remain the existing materialization owner.
observation_boundary.preparation: Only the separately authorized preparation observer supplies performed checks from the selected snapshot. The assessment is limited to these Define-owned conditions.
observation_boundary.handoff: Use existing native package inspection, original request binding and exact request/session matching before deriving HandoffRequest. Compare the compact session and context attachment against the actual full source snapshot. Request hash equality alone does not prove this correspondence.
observation_boundary.acknowledgement: Read actual response bytes through the selected read-only adapter, bind response_to and retain declared responder/posture. Recording a response is not semantic acceptance or proof of organization identity.
